verdict.rationale: Belvo is a hosted open-finance API platform, and asking whether such a product can be self-hosted or deployed on-premises is fair. The evidence pack documents only a cloud API, a sandbox, API keys, MCP servers and webhooks, with nothing about self-hosting or deploying the core product. The sandbox is a testing environment, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
